commonContract.connectionAnchors: View routing handles; never implicitly UML Port elements.
commonContract.semanticIdentity: Stable semantic element IDs referenced by one or more native views; geometry remains on views.
commonContract.history: One atomic operation per committed gesture with revision checks and undo.

validationModes.integrity: block invalid references and ownership corruption
validationModes.notation: explain warnings and allow intentional incomplete sketches

commonContract.interchange: Declare construct-level coverage per adapter; preserve original input and report unsupported or lossy mappings.

diagrams.title: Class diagram

hardConstraints: Keep compartments and member rows with their classifier.
Preserve containment, explicit relation ends and pinned views.

validationRequirements: Association ends reference valid classifiers and stable member IDs.
Generalization must not create an inheritance cycle.
Composition ownership and multiplicities are checked; marker choice follows relationship kind.
diagrams.interaction: Add a member from the compartment; connect to a classifier or a specific eligible member.

diagrams.title: Component diagram

hardConstraints: Keep named interface glyphs and ports attached to their owning component.
Preserve assembly/delegation endpoints and component containment.

validationRequirements: A connector must reference actual compatible roles/ports.
Provided and required interface contracts are distinct.
Display markers are derived from dependency, realization or connector semantics.
diagrams.interaction: Offer explicit Add UML port and Provide/Require interface actions; routing handles do not create either.

diagrams.title: Deployment diagram

hardConstraints: Preserve device/environment/artifact nesting.
Route communication paths between nodes; deployment relations retain their actual targets.

validationRequirements: Deployment targets resolve to valid deployment targets in the model.
Manifestation and deployment remain different relationship kinds.
Nested environments cannot create ownership cycles.
diagrams.interaction: Dropping an artifact into a runtime proposes its deployment relation as one undoable action.

diagrams.title: Object diagram

hardConstraints: Keep slot rows with their instance and preserve explicit link endpoints.
Never replace an instance view with its classifier during layout.

validationRequirements: Slots refer to features of the instance's classifier(s).
Referenced instance values and link ends must resolve.
Instance labels are underlined; incomplete classifier data is an explainable warning.
diagrams.interaction: Choose a classifier before adding typed slots; autocomplete its features and permitted values.

diagrams.title: Package diagram

hardConstraints: Preserve namespace nesting and pinned package boundaries.
External dependency routes must avoid unrelated package bodies.

validationRequirements: Ownership is acyclic.
Import, merge and ordinary dependency are stored separately.
Aliases and imported element references retain their targets after rename.
diagrams.interaction: Expand or collapse a package without dropping its cross-boundary references.

diagrams.title: Profile diagram

hardConstraints: Keep stereotypes in their profile and metaclass references visibly distinct.
Extension arrows remain attached to the relevant stereotype and metaclass.

validationRequirements: An extension identifies the stereotype and metaclass it extends.
Applied tagged values conform to declared property types.
Required extension and profile application are explicit; no automatic metamodel mutation.
diagrams.interaction: Select a metaclass when extending; inspect applied stereotype values on the modeled element.

diagrams.title: Composite structure diagram

hardConstraints: Keep part and port ownership; boundary ports stay on their owning perimeter.
Arrange internal parts without moving them outside the structured classifier.

validationRequirements: Each connector end refers to an eligible role or port.
Delegation and assembly are separate kinds with compatible endpoints.
Parts render as properties, not underlined instance specifications.
diagrams.interaction: Create semantic square ports explicitly; moving one updates attached internal and external connectors.

diagrams.title: Use case diagram

hardConstraints: Keep actors outside the subject boundary and use cases inside the selected subject.
Preserve include/extend direction and existing pins.

validationRequirements: Include points from the including use case to the included use case.
Extend points from the extending use case to the extended use case.
Generalization and extension-point references retain valid targets.
diagrams.interaction: Add include/extend from the relationship menu, with source/target roles shown in plain language.

diagrams.title: Activity diagram

hardConstraints: Preserve partitions, structured scopes and explicit branch guards.
Keep fork/join synchronization and distinguish flow-final from activity-final.

validationRequirements: Control and object flows have appropriate endpoint kinds.
Pins and object-flow types are checked where types are known.
Decision guards, join specifications and interrupting edges remain attached to their semantic elements.
diagrams.interaction: Quick insert offers a decision, fork, merge or action with appropriate endpoints; it does not invent branch conditions.

diagrams.title: State machine diagram

hardConstraints: Preserve region ownership, initial/history nodes and transition direction.
Keep internal transitions internal; route self-transitions without moving them to another state.

validationRequirements: Transitions resolve source/target states or valid pseudostates.
Pseudostate constraints and region ownership are checked by kind.
Trigger, guard and effect remain independent fields.
diagrams.interaction: Edit event [guard] / effect in separate fields; render the compact notation on the transition.

diagrams.title: Sequence diagram

hardConstraints: Preserve occurrence order, send/receive dependencies and fragment scope.
Move lifelines horizontally without reordering messages; explicit Reorder changes the model.
Creation/destruction bound the visible lifeline.

validationRequirements: Message occurrences resolve to valid lifelines/gates and remain ordered.
Combined-fragment operands and guards are explicit.
Supported operators are declared per stencil: alt, opt, loop, par, break, critical, neg, assert, strict, seq, ignore and consider.
diagrams.interaction: Insert a message between occurrences to create vertical room; message order is not inferred from arbitrary pixel positions.

diagrams.title: Communication diagram

hardConstraints: Preserve explicit message sequence expressions and nesting while moving participants.
Keep message arrows and labels on the appropriate connector.

validationRequirements: Each message has valid sender/receiver roles and a connector.
Sequence expressions such as 1, 1.1 and 1.2 remain explicit model data.
Changing layout never silently renumbers messages.
diagrams.interaction: Select a link to add a message; an ordered message panel offers deliberate reorder/renumber with preview.

diagrams.title: Interaction overview diagram

hardConstraints: Preserve interaction-use targets and control-flow direction.
Keep decision/merge and fork/join structures properly nested.

validationRequirements: Every ref resolves to an interaction or an explicitly unresolved reference.
Control-flow endpoints and paired branching/synchronization structures are checked.
Overview nodes remain interaction references or inline interactions, not ordinary action substitutes.
diagrams.interaction: Open a referenced sequence or other interaction in context; navigation preserves the overview selection.

diagrams.title: Timing diagram

hardConstraints: Preserve timestamps, symbolic ordering, shared time scale and duration constraints.
Only track spacing, label positions and routing change in Auto place.
Dragging a timed event requires an explicit time-edit gesture.

validationRequirements: All numeric times carry units and convert consistently.
Duration endpoints and observations resolve to valid occurrences.
Unknown times remain symbolic; arranging cannot invent measured values.
diagrams.interaction: Use a shared ruler and time Inspector; changing zoom never changes stored time or duration.
